findings.description: The Standard's account of the enlarged Empire Theater project in West Portal — 172 apartments on 12 floors with 7,000 square feet of ground-floor retail and 26 below-market units, up from 64 units across nine storeys — reported through the anxieties of the surrounding merchants. The same event as The Registry's story of 3 September 2026. Its factual detail is recorded as corroboration on finding 2026-09-06-reg-0001.

citation.label: The San Francisco Standard, “A West Portal project doubled in size. It’s the latest in SF’s ‘F your feelings’ era,” 5 September 2026

publish.note: One event, one entry — carried by finding 2026-09-06-reg-0001 in news/items/the-registry/2026-09-06.json, whose headline names the address and the scheme. This headline names neither, and the piece is built on named private individuals: the merchants, a property owner and a supervisor. Its numbers are still the better record of the scheme, so they are attached to the Registry finding as corroboration rather than lost.
